verdict.rationale: The axis applies, since a research notebook could plausibly run long background research jobs and notify the user. However, the evidence shows only interactive chat, source discovery, and artifact generation, with nothing documenting an unattended long-running research job or a completion notification. The ability to delay generations when out of AI limits (docs-50) is an adjacent quota-deferral feature, not the story's capability, so it earns no credit.
